title: Foil and Doo: A Tale of Two Jokers
original_title: Foil and Doo: A Tale of Two Jokers
overview: Foil and Doo are two clowns working a dead-end job in a supermarket. One day, they decide to branch out and go to Clowns Anonymous, where the leader is secretly working for the Clown Bureau of Investigation and recruits the two clowns.
